dispute_ticket.description: The rider never showed up at Tiong Bahru Plaza. I waited at the pickup for 9 minutes, called and messaged, then cancelled. The rider complained and the S$5.50 no-show fee is now on hold and I have not received it. Please release the fee to me.

pickup_location.name: Tiong Bahru Plaza (Kim Pong Road drop-off)

chat_logs.content: Hi, I'm at the Kim Pong Road drop-off point outside Tiong Bahru Plaza.
Waiting at the pickup point. Are you coming?
Outgoing call to rider - not answered (rang 25s, no response).
9 minutes now with no reply. Cancelling as no-show.
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee of $5.50 applied.

app_events.details: Rider R-9031 booked trip RYDE-CS-004 from Tiong Bahru Plaza (Kim Pong Road drop-off) to ION Orchard. Pickup 19:15.
Driver D-4825 (Ahmad Fauzi Bin Salleh, Toyota Wish (SLM 1180 J)) assigned.
Driver tapped 'I'm Here'. Arrival recorded for the pickup point.
Push notification + in-app alert sent to rider: 'Your driver has arrived.'
Wait timer started at driver arrival. 4 min free wait period ends at 19:17.
Free 4-min wait period expired. Rider had not boarded.
Driver initiated in-app call to rider. Call rang 25s, no answer.
Cancel pressed by driver D-4825. Reason selected: rider_no_show.
Cancellation fee S$5.50 held pending review (rider contested the charge). Not yet credited to driver.
Driver D-4825 released from trip. Trip status: cancelled (rider_no_show).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It covers rider cancellations and rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: Driver arrival is recorded at 19:13:00 with GPS at the pickup from 19:13 to 19:22. The driver pressed cancel at 19:22:00, a wait of 9 minutes, past this trip's 7-minute no-show threshold. The driver messaged and called; the rider's only reply, at 19:31, admits she was in a meeting. The no-show cancellation pressed by the driver after the threshold is covered by the policy, so the S$5.50 fee is due and the held amount is released to the driver.
